scope.completenessPolicy: This file contains the selected panel, every descendant control and popup item, plus the application/window/ribbon/tab ancestors needed to retain a valid hierarchy.
scope.locationModel: Resolve controls by application/window/ribbon/tab/panel ancestry, stable control IDs, region, and sibling order. Pixel coordinates and transient popup bounds must be detected from the current screenshot rather than hard-coded.

semantics.description: Opens the Constraint Settings dialog to the Geometric tab.
Applies multiple geometric constraints to the selected objects
Constrains two points to coincide, or a point to lie anywhere on an object or the extension of an object
Constrains two lines to lie on the same infinite line
Constrains selected circles, arcs, or ellipses to maintain the same center point
Constrains a point or a curve to a fixed location and orientation relative to the World Coordinate System
Constrains two lines to maintain the same angle
Constrains two lines, or polyline segments to maintain a 90-degree angle to each another
Constrains a line or pairs of points to lie parallel to the X-axis of the current UCS
Constrains lines or pairs of points to lie parallel to the Y-axis of the current UCS
Constrains two curves to maintain a point of tangency to each other or their extensions
Constrains a spline to be contiguous and maintain G2 continuity with another spline, line, arc, or polyline
Constrains two curves or points on objects to maintain symmetry about a selected line
Constrains two lines or polyline segments to maintain equal lengths, or arcs and circles to maintain equal radius values
Displays or hides geometric constraints for selected objects
Displays all geometric constraints in the drawing
Hides all geometric constraints in the drawing
